methodology: A listed firm needs either a current first-party page that names Kazakhstan as available (explicit) or a current first-party policy that describes global or country-based service availability and does not restrict residents or nationals of Kazakhstan (policy-supported), plus fresh structured records for every mapped product. This is explicit or policy-supported listing access, not a completed checkout from Kazakhstan, KYC approval, payout test, or legal opinion.

firms.sourceQuote: The lists below are the 203 countries and territories currently selectable in the checkout country dropdown on alphacapitalgroup.uk (source: live checkout configuration). Availability is always confirmed for your specific country at signup
firms.evidenceSummary: Alpha Capital's country-availability guide lists the 203 countries and territories selectable in its checkout country dropdown; Kazakhstan is named in the Asia (42) list.
firms.decisionNote: Nine captured configurations are mapped; Alpha Three is left out because Alpha says it is not currently offered for new purchases (checked 20 October 2026). The guide says its country names match the live signup dropdown (synced 23 July 2026) and that availability is confirmed for each country at signup, so recheck at checkout. Exact purchase availability remains unsettled for One variants and Swing. Guide page dated 30 June 2026.

firms.evidenceSummary: BrightFunded's policy names Cuba, Iran, North Korea, Syria, Vietnam and Pakistan for residence or nationality restrictions on challenge purchases and registration; it does not name Kazakhstan. This is not a completed checkout or individual eligibility approval.
firms.decisionNote: All 3 current CFD products are mapped. Recheck platform availability, KYC, and the final checkout before paying. Help article dated 15 September 2026.

firms.evidenceSummary: CTI's current terms (6.5.1) name Syria, North Korea, Cuba, and Iran as restricted jurisdictions for nationals or residents, and the site footer adds Russia and individuals under international sanctions; Kazakhstan is not listed.
firms.decisionNote: All 4 current product records are mapped. Recheck sanctions screening, KYC, and the payout route at signup.

firms.evidenceSummary: Crypto Fund Trader's Terms (7.3, Country Restrictions and Platform Availability) say Match-Trader has no country restrictions, and its FAQ says the same; no country list names Kazakhstan.
firms.decisionNote: The 3 current products sold to new buyers (Evaluation, Accelerated and Instant) are mapped on Match-Trader only; the Match-Trader statement is not applied to any other platform. Ascend and Break are not mapped because they are not sold to new buyers. Recheck KYC and the payout route at signup. Terms dated 30 March 2026.

firms.evidenceSummary: E8 publishes a restricted-country list for Classic markets + Perpetuals (35 names); Kazakhstan is not on that list.
firms.decisionNote: The 5 current structured products (E8 One, E8 Pro and E8 Signature, plus the E8 One and E8 Pro Perpetuals variants) are mapped to the Classic markets + Perpetuals list. KYC, platform-provider eligibility, payout-processor coverage, and any product-specific limitation still apply. Help article dated 1 October 2026.

firms.evidenceSummary: FundedNext publishes a resident-and-citizen restriction list for its CFD service (20 names); Kazakhstan is not on that list.
firms.decisionNote: All 4 current Stellar CFD products are mapped. Recheck the selected platform, add-ons, KYC identity, and payout route at signup. Help article dated 27 August 2026.

firms.sourceQuote: FundingPips does not accept traders resident in Iran, Vietnam, or the United Arab Emirates (UAE).
firms.evidenceSummary: FundingPips says it serves "195+ Countries" and names Iran, Vietnam, and the United Arab Emirates as restricted resident countries; Kazakhstan is not named.
firms.decisionNote: All 5 current models are mapped. The page footer also excludes residents of "countries on the FATF and EU/UN sanctions lists", so the three named countries are not the whole restriction set; recheck eligibility at signup. Payment methods vary by region, and MT5 or cTrader availability must be checked for the chosen account. Article updated 24 September 2026.

firms.sourceQuote: The following countries are prohibited from trading with FXIFY™:
firms.evidenceSummary: FXIFY publishes the jurisdictions it does not accept (35 names, plus the United States and Belarus in the site-footer list); Kazakhstan is not among them.
firms.decisionNote: All 10 current structured product rows (8 FOREX-labelled plus 2 crypto) are mapped. Recheck KYC, platform, and payout route at signup. FAQ page dated 12 February 2026.

firms.evidenceSummary: Maven's Terms page lists 25 restricted countries; Kazakhstan is not named.
firms.decisionNote: All 9 current products are mapped. The restricted list sits in the Terms page footer (Terms v2026.3, effective 5 November 2026), not in the Terms body. Recheck the reward method, KYC, and platform at signup.

firms.decisionNote: All 6 current Instant products are mapped. OFP says the list may be updated from time to time, so recheck at signup. Page last updated 8 May 2026.

firms.decisionNote: Both current Trading Combine paths are mapped. Eligibility depends on citizenship, residency, and KYC; recheck at signup. Help article dated 4 September 2026.

firms.evidenceSummary: TradeDay says it cannot accept citizens or residents of the countries on its prohibited list (83 names); Kazakhstan is not on that list.
firms.decisionNote: All 3 current products are mapped. Recheck citizenship, residency, and KYC at signup. Article dated 1 October 2026.
